mcp_servers.name: mt5
mcp_servers.use: Read-only MT5 access through a local bridge: market data, history, deal history and broker margin (calc_margin). Trading tools disabled (MT5_ENABLE_TRADING=0).

add_ons.python_packages: see the environment section (exact versions per run)

agents_used.name: web-fetch
agents_used.use: research only (broker holiday notice pages; access was blocked; no code produced)

other_tools: web search (broker notices and exchange calendars; research only)
ai_assistance.role: Wrote the strategy implementation, backtest engine, cost model and tests from owner-approved specifications, reviewed by the owner through pull requests, and ran the backtests. Strategy rules and risk limits were set and approved by the owner.

input_data.price_basis: bid OHLC per bar plus the bar's spread in points; ask = bid + spread
input_data.source: MetaTrader 5 terminal via the read-only mt5-mcp bridge (get_rates)
